label: In Fine's pure logic of ground, for every type of atoms and…, by Non-circularity-explosion-and…
meaning: A finite chain of derivable strict partial grounds collapses to one by the derived Transitivity(≺/≺); a cycle therefore yields A ≺ A, and a reversal B ≼ A of A ≺ B yields A ≺ A by Transitivity(≺/≼). Non-Circularity then derives every sequent, contradicting consistency. Derivable strict partial ground is thus transitive and irreflexive, and on a finite type of atoms Mathlib's Finite.wellFounded_of_trans_of_irrefl (classical) makes it well-founded.
